gaps.required_work: Capture exact git/worktree, dependency, environment, and optional container snapshot identity into a content-addressed checkpoint adapter with tamper tests.
Bind verification digests to exact commands, exit codes, output digests, dependency/environment identity, and test/build receipts rather than caller-provided verification hashes.
Materialize a verified checkpoint into an isolated worktree or container and prove the materialized state matches its stored digest before execution continues.
Execute approved rollback paths, restore the target snapshot, rerun verification, and emit a recovery receipt proving the resulting state exactly matches the selected ancestor.
Add durable local-first persistence for checkpoint metadata/artifact references with integrity checking, restart recovery, and concurrency-safe updates.
